quality_gate.failure_sample: Skills-first and generic component repositories matched workflow wording without being Workflow implementations.

next_action.hypothesis: Requiring an explicit executable workflow, pipeline, orchestration or automation asset in repository metadata before provisional eligibility will reduce topic contamination without promoting README claims to verified behavior.
next_action.metric: Compare the next batch non_eligible_rate and audit all rejected items for executable-workflow false negatives.
next_action.rollback_condition: Rollback if content evidence later shows that two or more metadata-rejected repositories contain first-class executable workflow definitions.
